title.narrative: Reducing deforestation and socio-environmental conflicts in the Amazon

description.narrative:
This project will contribute to reducing deforestation in the Amazon in Colombia and Peru by working with public servants, politicians, journalists and rural communities. In response to the complex panorama of deforestation and socio-environmental conflict in the region, this proposal aims to strengthen the environmental governance in strategic areas of the Colombian and Peruvian Amazon as an enabling condition to prevent forest loss and promote prosperity and well-being of local communities.
The achievement of this objective is envisioned through the implementation of four expected outcomes: 1) Generate information that is holistic, independent, timely, reliable and that supports and drives the intersectoral actions of decision makers and contributes to the strengthening of instruments to protect the Amazon. 2) Design and implement capacity building processes that allow key institutions to act in a coordinated and more effective manner to improve environmental governability in the Colombian and Peruvian Amazon. 3) Promote an advocacy strategy that calls for comprehensive State action for the recovery of environmental governability in the Amazon, and greater social awareness of the importance of its conservation. 4) Consolidate a model of territorial transformations based on governance schemes, access to territorial rights and promotion of the forest economy that will improve the prosperity and well-being of communities and the protection of areas of special environmental importance.
